scenarios.prompt: A deck ruleset moves stable card IDs through deck, hand, discard and exhaust zones using a deterministic shuffle stream.

criteria.identity: deck_ruleset_id/revision, card_id and canonical zones are explicit.
criteria.rng: Shuffle/draw randomness is owned by rng-seed and reproducible when required.
criteria.transaction: Zone moves are idempotent transactions and presentation order is not canonical zone truth.
